text.p: Pharmos Corp said Friday it signed an international marketing agreement with Bausch & Lomb Pharmaceuticals Inc., a Tampa, Florida-based subsidiary of Bausch & Lomb Inc.

The international agreement grants Bausch & Lomb Pharmaceuticals the rights to market the Lotemax (loteprednol etabonate ophthalmic suspension, 0.5 percent) product line upon receipt of regulatory clearances.
In a separate agreement, Pharmos said Bausch & Lomb made a $2 million investment in its common stock.
The product line in the marketing pact consists of Lotemax, an ophthalmic steroid, plus a loteprednol etabonate-based allergy product and a combination antibiotic product.

The agreement covers non-U.S. territories, including Europe, Canada and selected other countries. The agreement specifies a total of $1.6 million in milestone payments tied to receipt of regulatory clearances and is in addition to the existing June, 1995 arrangement with Bausch & Lomb for marketing the Lotemax product line in the U.S.
To date, Lotemax has been evaluated in pivotal phase III trials. Pharmos Corp has completed its final phase III study and in early 1997 plans to amend its previously filed NDA.
The company has also completed pivotal phase III trials of the loteprednol allergy product with NDA filing expected in early 1997.
